messages:
Alex K: Quick sync — we're doing a staggered rollout for the embed model swap + v1->v2 SDK param rename next week. Need owners for docs PRs, redirect strategy, and smoke-test checklist.

Jen L: Assigned myself to the migration guide PR. I'll split into: overview, quick upgrade, migration examples, and rollback notes.

Sam R: I'll own the snippet updates for python/js/ruby. Can you confirm the param rename again?

Alex K: Old param is `embed_dim` -> new param `vector_dim`. Also new SDK throws a specific error for mismatched dims, so call that out.

Tyler: For example snippets, recommend adding both old and new calls side-by-side for 1-2 releases:
```python
# v1 (deprecated)
client.embed(model="text-embed-v1", embed_dim=1536, input="...")
# v2 (new)
client.embeddings.create(model="text-embed-002", vector_dim=1536, input="...")
```

Maria P: Redirects: we need to add /docs/embedding/old -> /docs/embeddings/migration with 302 for 48h then 301. CDN TTL change required. I'll open infra ticket for edge TTL.

Jen L: Good call. Also adding a short FAQ section: "what happens if my app assumes 768 dims?" with recommended fallback code.

Sam R: Smoke tests: propose a small script that validates vector length and a semantic similarity quick-check. I'll link to the harness: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs-smoke

Alex K: Checklist items:
- PRs: migration guide, snippets, redirects, changelog note
- PR labels: `docs:migration`, `release:next`
- Owners: Jen (guide), Sam (snippets), Maria (redirects)
- Add a short deprecation blurb at top of v1 pages
- Add explicit example showing SDK error and how to handle:
```js
try {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-002', vector_dim: 1536, input: '...' })
} catch (err) {
  if (err.code === 'VECTOR_DIM_MISMATCH') {
    console.warn('Update your embed_dim/vector_dim to match model output');
  }
}
```

Tyler: One small UX ask: keep the inline code examples consistent (either `client.embed` vs `client.embeddings.create`) across guides to avoid confusion.

Maria P: I've created infra ticket #INF-1129 for the redirect + CDN TTL change. ETA 48h.

Jen L: PR checklist in the migration guide will include a checkbox: "run docs smoke script and paste output". Also link to snippets test harness that Sam will add.

Sam R: I'll add a GitHub Actions job `docs-smoke` that runs a handful of example calls against the staging deploy and asserts dims + semantic similarity > 0.7.

Alex K: Timeline: land PRs by Wed EOD, smoke tests passing by Thu AM, staging rollout Thu PM, production redirect and deprecation announcement Fri 10:00 PT.

Jen L: Flagging one edge case — customers using custom quantized models via Dedicated. Add a note: contact support for dedicated model aliasing & pinning.

Maria P: Also recommend a short note in the console UI: "Embedding dim change incoming — see migration guide". I'll ping product to add that banner.

Tyler: Can someone paste the migration quick command we'll put in the CLI docs?

Sam R: Sure — CLI example: `redwood migrate-embeddings --from embed_dim --to vector_dim --check` (we'll flesh out flags).

Alex K: Action items summary (I'll @mention owners in PR body):
- Jen: migration guide draft + FAQ
- Sam: update snippets + add GH Action
- Maria: redirects + infra ticket + console banner request
- Tyler: final snippet review + consistency pass

docs-ci: Reminder — merge will trigger `docs-smoke` job. Failures will block the `release:next` tag.

deploy-bot: Scheduled staging deploy for docs at 1769876600 (Thu PM).

Jen L: Thanks all — I'll open the guide PR now and add the checklist. Please add quick review comments as you see fit.

Alex K: Perfect. We'll keep this thread for follow-ups. If anything slips, escalate to the release channel. :thumbsup:
